profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Electronic Arts (EA)
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer games industry. Skilled in C#, Microsoft SQL Server, and other technologies. Graduated from The University of Texas at Austin with a degree in Computer Science and a Certificate in Digital Arts and Media.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Working with a variety of technologies for the development systems team. 
Some responsibilities are:
- Providing support on voice over tools, which includes development to improve existing workflows and fixing bugs.
- Being knowledgeable of the localization system(s) at BioWare.
- Communicating with teams across locations to ensure they get the information they need from our localization system.
